# Settings

> Every setting the *Label Studio — Labels, Barcodes & Data* extension contributes, with its type, default and allowed values, generated from `package.json` `contributes.configuration`.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `labelStudio.defaultFormat` | `string` | `"auto"` | Printer language assumed for files that do not declare one (.prn, .lbl). `auto` sniffs the content. Allowed: `"auto"`, `"zpl"`, `"epl"`. |
| `labelStudio.renderer.density` | `string` | `"8dpmm"` | Print density used when rendering labels. Matches the target printer's resolution. Allowed: `"6dpmm"`, `"8dpmm"`, `"12dpmm"`, `"24dpmm"`. |
| `labelStudio.label.widthInches` | `number` | `4` | Label width in inches. Range: 0.25 to 15. |
| `labelStudio.label.heightInches` | `number` | `6` | Label height in inches. Range: 0.25 to 30. |
| `labelStudio.preview.autoRefresh` | `boolean` | `true` | Automatically refresh the preview as the document changes. |
| `labelStudio.preview.autoRefreshDelay` | `number` | `400` | Debounce delay (ms) for preview auto-refresh. Range: 100 to 5000. |
| `labelStudio.preview.initialZoom` | `number` | `2` | Initial display scale for the preview (1 = 1 dot per pixel). Range: 0.25 to 8. |
| `labelStudio.format.uppercaseCommands` | `boolean` | `true` | Uppercase ZPL commands when formatting. EPL command case is significant and is never changed. |
| `labelStudio.format.oneCommandPerLine` | `boolean` | `true` | Place each ZPL command on its own line when formatting. |
| `labelStudio.validation.enable` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable diagnostics for label documents. |
| `labelStudio.validation.barcodeData` | `boolean` | `true` | Check barcode payloads against the symbology's character set, length and check digit. |
| `labelStudio.validation.bounds` | `boolean` | `true` | Report fields that fall outside the printable area. |
| `labelStudio.validation.scannability` | `boolean` | `true` | Report bar widths, bar heights and quiet zones that are likely to fail a scanner. |
| `labelStudio.merge.maxRows` | `number` | `500` | Maximum number of data rows expanded by a single merge. Range: 1 to 100000. |
| `labelStudio.import.threshold` | `number` | `128` | Luminance threshold (0-255) below which an imported image pixel becomes a printed dot. Range: 1 to 254. |
| `labelStudio.import.dither` | `string` | `"none"` | Dithering applied when converting imported artwork to 1 bit per pixel. Use `none` for logos and line art. Allowed: `"none"`, `"floyd-steinberg"`. |
| `labelStudio.import.maxWidthDots` | `number` | `600` | Imported images wider than this many dots are scaled down to fit. Range: 8 to 4000. |
| `labelStudio.import.invert` | `boolean` | `false` | Swap black and white when importing artwork. Use for light logos meant to print on a dark field. |
| `labelStudio.import.trim` | `boolean` | `false` | Crop blank margins from imported artwork so the graphic starts where the ink does. |
| `labelStudio.import.rotate` | `number` | `0` | Rotate imported artwork clockwise by this many degrees. Allowed: `0`, `90`, `180`, `270`. |
| `labelStudio.deploy.confirmBeforeSend` | `boolean` | `true` | Ask for confirmation before sending a label to a printer. |
| `labelStudio.deploy.timeoutMs` | `number` | `10000` | How long to wait for a network printer before giving up. Range: 500 to 120000. |
| `labelStudio.printers` | `array` | `[]` | Printers labels can be deployed to. |

## Object settings

### `labelStudio.printers` entries

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` (required) | `string` | — | Display name, e.g. `Warehouse ZT411`. |
| `transport` | `string` | `"tcp"` | `tcp` sends to a network printer, `file` writes to a device or share, `directory` drops a spool file. Allowed: `"tcp"`, `"file"`, `"directory"`. |
| `host` | `string` | — | Hostname or IP address (tcp transport). |
| `port` | `number` | `9100` | TCP port; raw printing is 9100 on virtually every printer. |
| `path` | `string` | — | Device path, share or spool directory (file/directory transports). |
| `format` | `string` | `"zpl"` | Printer language. Labels written in the other language are converted on deploy. Allowed: `"zpl"`, `"epl"`. |
| `dpmm` | `number` | `8` | Print density in dots per millimetre. Allowed: `6`, `8`, `12`, `24`. |
| `widthInches` | `number` | — | Stock width in inches. |
| `heightInches` | `number` | — | Stock height in inches. |
| `append` | `boolean` | `false` | Append to the target file instead of replacing it (file transport). |
| `description` | `string` | — | Free-text note shown in the printers view. |
